mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_sales_daily (stat_date, sku_id, qty_sold) SELECT s.stat_date, s.sku_id, s.qty_sold FROM ( SELECT DATE(o.paid_time) AS stat_date, i.sku_id AS sku_id, SUM(i.quantity) AS qty_sold FROM shop_order o JOIN shop_order_item i ON i.order_id = o.id WHERE o.order_status IN ('WAIT_SHIP', 'SHIPPED', 'COMPLETED') AND o.paid_time IS NOT NULL AND o.paid_time >= #{startDate} AND o.paid_time < #{endDate} AND i.sku_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DATE(o.paid_time), i.sku_id ) AS s ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE qty_sold = s.qty_sold
